name: Roasted Lamb
description: A slow-roasted lamb recipe with a flavorful garlic and rosemary paste, perfect for a tender and aromatic main course.

recipeInstructions.text: Make a paste with olive oil, butter, garlic, and rosemary.
Make small holes in the lamb and insert garlic cloves or pieces.
Smear the lamb with the prepared paste.
Sprinkle with flour and place in a roasting pan.
Add a scant amount of water to the pan and sprinkle rosemary on top.
Roast slowly at 250°F to 300°F for 6 to 7 hours or until done.
Remove the lid near the end to brown the lamb.

keywords: roasted lamb, garlic and rosemary, slow cooking

_similar.name: Chicken Glazed with Basil & Balsamic Vinegar
_similar.description: A glazed chicken breast recipe with basil, balsamic vinegar, and honey.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Place chicken breasts in a shallow baking dish.
In a saucepan, bring remaining ingredients to a boil.
Remove from heat and pour over chicken.
Bake for 20-30 minutes or until chicken is cooked, basting occasionally with the glaze.
Serve warm or cold.

_similar.name: Pizza Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty pizza casserole made with spaghetti, hamburger, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp cooking oil or olive oil

recipeInstructions.text: Cook spaghetti as per package instructions and drain.
In a bowl, combine cooked spaghetti, margarine or butter, eggs, and Parmesan cheese.
Spread the spaghetti mixture in a greased 9x13 inch pan.
Brown hamburger and onion in a skillet and spoon over the spaghetti mixture.
Spread spaghetti sauce over the hamburger mixture and cover with mozzarella cheese.
Sprinkle with oregano and drizzle with oil.
Arrange pepperoni slices on top.
Bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Lemon Chicken With Thyme
_similar.description: A flavorful chicken dish made with lemon juice, thyme, and a light flour coating, served with lemon wedges and parsley.
recipeIngredient: Lemon halves and chopped parsley for garnish (optional)

recipeInstructions.text: In a plastic bag, combine flour, salt, and pepper. Add chicken and shake to coat lightly.
In a large skillet, warm oil over medium heat. Brown chicken about 5 minutes each side. Transfer to a plate.
Coarsely chop the onion. Add margarine to the skillet and stir until softened, 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in reserved flour and combine. Add chicken broth, lemon juice, and thyme. Bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Return chicken to skillet, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover. Cook until chicken is tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve with lemon wedges and a sprinkling of parsley, if desired.

_similar.name: Curry Chicken

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix all ingredients except chicken breasts in a microwave-safe bowl until butter is melted.
Arrange chicken breasts in a shallow baking dish sprayed with nonstick spray.
Pour the curry mixture over the chicken breasts.
Bake uncovered for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
Serve over rice.

_similar.name: Creamy Chicken Stew
_similar.description: A hearty and comforting chicken stew with vegetables in a creamy sauce.
recipeIngredient: 3 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a Dutch oven. Sprinkle chicken with salt, pepper, and paprika. Cook and stir until the chicken is browned. Drain.
Add raw vegetables, basil, bay leaf, celery salt, and 5 cups broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Remove bay leaf. Add canned vegetables. Cook and stir for 2 minutes.
In a saucepan, mix flour and butter or margarine until smooth. Gradually whisk in remaining 2 cups broth. Bring to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
Pour the sauce into the Dutch oven. Stir and bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer, uncovered, for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with rolls or biscuits.

_similar.keywords: chicken stew, creamy stew, comfort food
